comment: Dependencies required by this kit. SpecimenShowcase needs only React. LanthanumBohrScroll additionally needs three + @react-three/fiber.

compatibility.react: @react-three/fiber v9 requires React 19. On React 18, install @react-three/fiber@^8 instead; the component code works unchanged.
compatibility.typescript: Components are TSX with strict-friendly types; plain-JS projects can rename to .jsx and delete the type annotations.
